sentences.text: Malefica was a type of hadrosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
The single known species within this genus is Malefica deckerti.
This animal belongs to the large family Hadrosauridae.
Scientists first found a partial left maxilla in 2002 and initially placed it in the genus Kritosaurus.
Twenty years later, researchers described it as a new taxon based on useful diagnostic traits.
Prieto-Márquez and Wagner named both the genus and species in 2022.
Phylogenetic analysis recovered Malefica as a basal member of Hadrosauridae, outside the clade Saurolophidae.
Fossils come from the Texan side of the Aguja Formation, which also appears in Mexico.
The time range for Malefica is recorded as Campanian, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
